If you have denied geolocation access to the app, you will have to re-enable it to allow auto filling location data on sets.

The process to do so differs on Android and iOS systems. Images here may not apply to every device model even within identical operating systems and should be taken as a general visual aid.

For Android Devices

  • Open your device's Settings app and go to the 'Security and Privacy' tab. Within that click on the 'Privacy' option.
  • Click on the 'Permission manager' option and then on the 'Location' option
  • Click on the 'Chrome' option
  • Click on 'Allow only while using the app'. Ensure that 'Use precise location' is enabled

For Apple/iOS Devices

  • Open your device's Settings app and go to the 'Privacy & Security' tab. Within that click on the 'Location Services' option.
  • Ensure Location Services are enabled and that the option for Safari Websites is 'While Using the App'
  • Back in the main Settings app menu go to the 'Safari' option further down.
  • With the 'Safari' menu got to Location and within there ensure the 'Allow' option is checked.
  • Within the app, if geolocation is still not working then refresh the app (swipe down gesture) or close and reopen the app.
