• Getting started
    • Use the same phone to sign up for an account and record logbook data. At this time, you will not see your data if you log in to a different device.
    • Access the app at {{website}} , then use Save to Home Screen options to download as an app for offline use. For more details, see the Download The App section.
    • Create your account and confirm your email.
  • Logbook Data Collection
    • In "Sets and Catch" record set information (dates, locations, times, gear) and catch details.
    • In "Current Delivery" record fish tickets, landing details, vessel and permit information. Verify the sets included in your landing here.
  • Logbook Submission
    • After landing, submit data from the link at the bottom of the "Current Delivery" page.
    • Until you submit a logbook, the information is only stored on your phone.
    • Submit data within 24 hours of landing.
