• At the login screen, choose the option at the bottom to "Sign Up"
  • Complete all fields on the next screen and tap the red "Sign Up" button
  • Next add your vessel(s). Choose the red + button and add vessel name and number
  • If the vessel is not recognized, a warning will ask you to check for errors. Not all vessels will be recognized, so choose "Continue" if all vessel information is correct.
  • An email will be sent to confirm the address you used at sign-up. Be sure to read and follow the directions in the email or you will not be able to submit your logbook.
